old_caption: The video captures a serene scene by a lakeside where a group of ducks is swimming near the shore. The water is active with ripples, reflecting the surrounding greenery and the overcast sky above. The ducks are scattered across the water, some closer to the shore while others are further out, creating gentle ripples around them. The shoreline is lined with lush green grass and a few patches of dirt, with a large tree trunk partially submerged in the water, adding a natural element to the setting. The camera shows slight shifts in perspective and focus, indicating minor motion or adjustment.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene scene by a lakeside where a group of ducks is swimming near the shore. The water is calm, reflecting the surrounding greenery and the overcast sky above. The ducks are scattered across the water, some closer to the shore while others are further out, creating gentle ripples around them. The shoreline is lined with lush green grass and a few patches of dirt, with a large tree trunk partially submerged in the water, adding a natural element to the setting. The ducks appear to be foraging or simply enjoying their time in the water. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, with no significant movement or action occurring beyond the ducks' gentle swimming and occasional splashes. The camera remains stationary throughout the video, focusing on capturing the tranquil moment by the lake.
caption: The video captures a quiet pond edge on an overcast day, where a muddy sloping bank on the left meets shallow water beneath a leaning tree trunk and bright green grass. Feathery evergreen branches hang across the top of the frame, and a flat rectangular tile rests at the waterline. A loose line of small dark ducks floats close to the bank, arranged from the tile toward the lower right. Several hold a head-down, tail-up dabbling posture, bobbing in place as concentric ripples continuously emanate and expand outward across the surface. These overlapping rings pass through the brownish reflection of the tree on the open water to the right, deforming and shimmering it without disturbing any separate object. The duck at the lower end turns its head slightly while staying in the same spot. The bank, grass, trunk, tile, and branches remain fixed throughout, indicating a stationary camera observing this ongoing activity.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
